scope: Two Spring server contexts in one test JVM, each observed by a fresh browser process, sharing one disposable PostgreSQL instance; no reseeding.
steps: Capture the complete ordered policy, event, and idempotency rows.
Read policy renewal-demo through the first Spring server context; require HTTP 200 and the exact eight-field response.
Compare complete database rows while the first context is still alive, then stop that context.
Start a second Spring server context against the same PostgreSQL instance; compare rows before reading.
Read through a fresh browser process; require HTTP 200, semantic response equality, all matching panel fields, and no mutation request.
Compare complete database rows while the second context is still alive, then stop that context and compare once more.

expectedUi.notice: Reference only; not a renewal offer or coverage commitment.

expectedPersistedState.policyTable: all complete ordered rows identical at every stated checkpoint
expectedPersistedState.eventTable: all complete ordered rows identical at every stated checkpoint
expectedPersistedState.idempotencyTable: all complete ordered rows identical at every stated checkpoint

limitation: Synthetic local rehearsal only; does not establish PostgreSQL crash durability, packaged-JAR execution, production authentication, renewal pricing, or customer acceptance.
